title: Ta Heuriskomena Panta, Greek opera omnia incl. Triads (Migne PG 150-151, 1865)
author: Gregory Palamas
description: A collected Greek edition of Gregory Palamas's writings, including material associated with the Triads. It provides access to a central voice in the defence of hesychast prayer and Eastern Christian mystical theology.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/taheuriskomenap00germgoog).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
